time_reference: All timestamps UTC ISO8601, Z suffix; elapsed hours relative to courses.csv anchor_utc

record_resolution.pump_events: event_id is unique. revises_id points to a preceding event_id in the same infusion. Discard any row referenced by revises_id, including intermediate revisions; retain terminal rows only. Sort retained rows by effective_utc, then recorded_utc and event_id. SET sets infusion rate_mg_h (positive); STOP sets rate to zero. An infusion starts at rate zero and rate stays constant until next retained event. Aggregate rates across infusion_id for each course. recorded_utc determines neither medication administration time nor dose.
record_resolution.drug_levels: Group by (course_id,specimen_id), retain maximum integer revision. Accept the retained row only when status is FINAL, concentration_mg_l > 0, and collection_utc is strictly after anchor_utc and at most 48 hours after. Ignore result_utc for clinical sampling time. Excluded count = all raw drug_levels rows not used in fitting, including superseded revisions. n_levels counts accepted specimens.
record_resolution.renal_labs: Sort by collection_utc. For any time t, use the most recent creatinine_mg_dl measured at or before t; hold its value until the next measurement, including after the last value. All courses have a renal measurement at anchor.

pharmacokinetics.concentration_model: Central amount A1 and peripheral amount A2: dA1/dt = R(t) - (CL(t)+Q)*A1/Vc + Q*A2/Vp; dA2/dt = Q*A1/Vc - Q*A2/Vp; observed central concentration C=A1/Vc. Initial amounts zero. CL(t)=CL0*(1.0/Scr(t))^0.65.
pharmacokinetics.integration: Exact two-compartment linear state-space solution on piecewise-constant rate and creatinine segments. Both compartment amounts remain continuous at boundaries.
pharmacokinetics.optimization: For accepted levels, minimize sum squared central-concentration residuals divided by 0.7^2 plus squared log-ratio penalties: log(CL0/CL_prior)/0.6, log(Vc/Vc_prior)/0.5, log(Vp/Vp_prior)/0.35 and log(Q/Q_prior)/0.45. Use the global minimum over parameter bounds. Ties resolved by smallest lexicographic parameter tuple.
pharmacokinetics.insufficient_levels: If fewer than 3 accepted specimens, output status=insufficient_levels, n_levels as accepted count, blank cl_l_h/v_l/auc24_mg_h_l, and no regimen_scores rows.

regimen_projection.history: Use modeled actual concentration immediately before 48h, replace any future pump administration with the candidate option; retain future Scr measurements and hold last Scr thereafter.
regimen_projection.dosing: For each option, infuse dose_mg uniformly across infusion_h at t=48+ k*interval_h for all k whose starts precede 72h; cut contribution at t=72.

ranking.rule: Rank options first by whether predicted 24h AUC lies within [400,600] inclusive (inside first); then ascending absolute difference from 500; then ascending total dose administered over 48-72h; then option_id alphabetical. Ranks are 1-based, unique. The preferred regimen has rank 1.

output.float_format: decimal, at least 6 digits after decimal for nonblank numeric values
output.sorting: exposure by course_id; regimen scores by course_id then rank

eligibility: All 240 courses in courses.csv are eligible.
